court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Pune, Marriage Petition No.A-389/2018
case_name: Smt. Kavita Balasanotsh Vannier vs Mr. Balasantosh Chandran Vannier
facts_of_case: Wife seeks to transfer divorce petition filed by husband from Kalyan to Family Court at Pune due to her poor health and father's senior citizenship. Husband failed to pay interim maintenance despite court order.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that there is a change in circumstances justifying transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: In view of subsequent development, this Court vide order dated 22.11.2016 disposed of applicant's application u/s 24 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

legal_principles.principle: A party's personal disability or inconvenience is not a sufficient ground to oppose the transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Apart from that respondent is partially disabled as he lost sight of left eye. Therefore, it is difficult for him to travel from Kalyan to Pune if the matter is transferred there.

outcome.final_order: Court allows wife's application to transfer divorce petition to Family Court at Pune for hearing and final disposal on its own merits.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure
